title: Identification and validation of BCL11A as a neural and immune vulnerability factor in pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
authors: Chen, Aotian; Wang, Jialun; Yang, Jiaying; Wang, Yue; Wu, Chenchen; Yang, Huaina; Fan, Yaoyao; Gao, Qing; Hu, Yiqiao; Li, Xihan; Zou, Xiaoping
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胰腺癌中BCL11A的预后与免疫作用，仅涉及基因表达与功能实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As a highly malignant tumor, pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) has nonspecific symptoms and a poor prognosis. Previous studies have demonstrated that perineural invasion (PNI) and neurotrophic factors (NFs) play essential roles in PAAD. Nevertheless, the prognostic significance and functions of NF-related genes (NFRGs) in PAAD remain unclear. In this research, we conducted an intersection analysis utilizing differentially expressed genes (DEGs) found in the TCGA-PAAD cohort along with NFRGs from the Genecard. Using machine learning (ML) techniques, including LASSO regression, SVM-RFE and random forest algorithms, we developed a highly accurate prognostic model centered on NFRGs, ultimately pinpointing BCL11A as the crucial prognostic NFRG. Via analysis of the TCGA cohort, immunohistochemistry of 20 pairs of clinical samples and western blot of PAAD cell lines, BCL11A was found to be low-expressed in PAAD and associated with a poor prognosis. Experiments conducted both in vitro and in vivo revealed that the increased expression of BCL11A suppressed tumor growth and triggered apoptosis through endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress. Moreover, immune infiltration analysis found increased CD8(+) T cells in the BCL11A(high) group. Flow cytometry demonstrated that overexpression of BCL11A in vivo promoted intratumoral CD8(+) T cell infiltration and activation, and increased PD-L1 expression. Our study confirmed BCL11A as a potential biomarker of clinical prognosis, immune infiltration, and neural-tumor interactions in PAAD, and might provide new insights for diagnosis and treatment of this tumor.
abstract_zh: 作为一种高度恶性肿瘤，胰腺腺癌（PAAD）具有非特异性症状和不良预后。既往研究表明，神经周围浸润（PNI）和神经营养因子（NFs）在PAAD中发挥重要作用。然而，NF相关基因（NFRGs）在PAAD中的预后意义及功能仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用TCGA-PAAD队列中发现的差异表达基因（DEGs）与来自Genecard的NFRGs进行了交集分析。通过采用机器学习（ML）技术，包括LASSO回归、SVM-RFE和随机森林算法，我们构建了一个以NFRGs为核心的高精度预后模型，最终确定BCL11A为关键的预后NFRG。通过对TCGA队列的分析、20对临床样本的免疫组织化学检测以及PAAD细胞系的蛋白质印迹分析，发现BCL11A在PAAD中低表达，并与不良预后相关。体外和体内实验表明，BCL11A表达增加通过内质网（ER）应激抑制肿瘤生长并触发细胞凋亡。此外，免疫浸润分析发现BCL11A高表达组中CD8(+) T细胞增多。流式细胞术显示，体内BCL11A过表达促进了瘤内CD8(+) T细胞的浸润和活化，并增加了PD-L1表达。我们的研究证实BCL11A是PAAD中临床预后、免疫浸润及神经-肿瘤相互作用的潜在生物标志物，并可能为该肿瘤的诊断和治疗提供新的见解。
